notes._summary: Approved cmark-gfm 0.29.0.gfm.13 divergence baseline after issue #144. Of the 58 semantic / 29 visual failures recorded on main, the parser/renderer fixes in this change (GFM table thead/tbody + align attribute, task-list leading space, GFM bare-URL/email autolink postprocess, GFM single+double-tilde strikethrough, plus per-case autolink gating for the CommonMark-core Autolinks section) resolve 38 semantic / 20 visual cases. The 20 semantic / 9 visual cases below remain and are tracked here as documented divergence rather than regressions; each is either a deliberate spec-correct stance or out-of-scope future work.
notes.spec-0398: Emphasis: cmark 0.29 emits flat output where the CommonMark emphasis algorithm (delimiter runs, rule of 3) mandates nesting. Supramark's parser is spec-correct; matching cmark 0.29 would require reintroducing the known cmark emphasis bug. See issue #144 (emphasis divergence).
notes.spec-0426: Emphasis: same cmark-0.29 flat-vs-nested divergence as spec-0398; parser is spec-correct.

notes.spec-0280: GFM task list: cmark-gfm renders the checkbox as `<input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox">` (specific attribute set and order). Supramark's web renderer emits a different checkbox shape; the AST (task-list item with leading space) is correct. Tracked as future renderer work.
notes.spec-0652: Disallowed Raw HTML: GFM tagfilter (escaping disallowed block-level raw HTML tags) is not yet implemented. Tracked as future work.
notes.extensions-0012: Embedded HTML inside a GFM table cell: inline HTML within a cell is not yet promoted to a raw node (`hello` stays as text). Tracked as future parser work.
notes.extensions-0019: Compound autolink case (mailto:/xmpp: prefixes, unicode hosts, `mmmmailto:`, nested email-within-path). The www/scheme/email matchers cover the common sub-scenarios; a few edge forms (notably `mailto:`/`xmpp:` prefix preservation and double-email paths) still diverge. Tracked as future work.
notes.extensions-0020: Autolink crash-safety edge case `(_A_@_.A` renders as the cmark-gfm internal `<IGNORE>` sentinel. This is a cmark-gfm implementation detail, not a real rendering target; tracked as an excluded case.
notes.extensions-0022: HTML tag filter: GFM tagfilter (escaping disallowed block-level raw HTML tags such as <title>, <textarea>, <style>, <iframe>, <script>) is not yet implemented. Tracked as future work.

Footnotes: GFM renders footnote definitions as a trailing `
  1. ...
` with backrefs; Supramark currently renders them inline as `

`. Tracked as future work.
notes.extensions-0024: Footnotes: multiple references should insert multiple backrefs; depends on the GFM footnote section format (extensions-0023).
notes.extensions-0025: Footnotes: reference-label hrefs must be percent-escaped; depends on the GFM footnote section format (extensions-0023).
notes.extensions-0029: GFM task list: checkbox rendering divergence (self-closing `<input ... />` and attribute set/order; the `[@]` non-task marker is handled as literal). AST is correct; tracked as future renderer work.
